author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Apple and NSA services faced outages as Equinor reported a cyberattack, highlighting the risks facing increasingly connected infrastructure. Apple customers faced widespread service problems on November 17, with issues affecting iCloud, the App Store, Apple Music and AppleCare on Device. The disruption came after a week of technical failures involving major technology companies, banking services […]
title: Apple Services Disrupted as NSA Network Goes Down and Equinor Faces Cyberattack

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Hackers used compromised Fireworks AI credentials to steal personal data and driver’s license information belonging to nearly 150,000 Uber users. Uber is notifying nearly 150,000 people after attackers used compromised credentials belonging to one of its technology providers to access personal information stored in the company’s external environment. “On October 9, 2026, a service provider […]
title: Fireworks AI Breach Exposes Uber Data and Highlights Supply Chain Risks

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Midnight Blue found six unpatched remote takeover flaws in Danfoss AK-SM800A controllers in under an hour. Agencies agree: take them off the internet. Since 11 October, attackers have been hitting internet-exposed fridge controllers from Danfoss and Copeland across Europe, starting in France. They triggered defrost cycles, spoiled food worth tens of millions of euros and […]
title: Fridge Controller Attacks: Researchers Find Six Zero-Days in an Hour

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: A breach at an Infoblox supplier exposed customer network snapshots and employee data, highlighting the risks of trusted third-party access. Infoblox, one of the major players in cybersecurity and network infrastructure, is investigating a data breach after attackers gained access to internal company information through a compromised third-party provider. The incident is more serious than […]
title: Infoblox Confirms Supply Chain Breach After Attackers Access Sensitive Data

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: OPTIMJACK: Attackers hijacked Optimizely scripts on 178 organizations’ websites, spreading malware to steal crypto, payment card data and target iPhones. title: OPTIMJACK: BBC, CNN and Zoom Among Targets of Optimizely Script Hijacking

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Greiz hospital reopens its emergency room after an extortion attack. Investigators are probing the case, but no state links have emerged. The Greiz-Ronneburg district hospital in Thuringia reported its system failure on Saturday evening, 14 November. By Sunday morning the emergency room was out of service. On Monday evening, 16 November, it started to reopen […]
title: Germany: Greiz Hospital Reopens Emergency Room After Ransom Attack
